posts.name: The Mariner
posts.cooked:
Consider the following:

We've been analyzing the PWX as variants of the Prime Wardens.  However, in-universe, wouldn't we expect that they'd have their own unique backstories?  We've seen an AA who learned to just SCREAM ALL THE TIME because he was stranded on an island with no other source of music.  What if we need to see a CC who, surrounded by his enemies, cheated death, but payed the price of sanity?  This is my current theory: CC deals himself "fatal" damage while Fixed Point is in play.  Probably has a bunch of Constructs in play for good measure.  Because PWX CC has Judge Mental on his flip side, I'll see about a team game with CC vs. Judge Mental.

 

UPDATE: It's hard to time your death in Vengeance Mode, so I'm also considering two other things: CC killing Heroic Infinitor (it may be evil but it's certainly Xtreme), and having ALL the Constructs in play.  Not just each type, but literally every construct in your deck.

UPDATE THE SECOND: Neither of the UPDATE things worked, even when I did a massive, 22-damage Construct Cataclysm. I still haven't tested the first bit because again, it's hard to make ANYTHING happen like it's supposed to in Vengeance mode.

I used the following team for both XPWAA and XPWCC in the following order and vs. Ambuscade:

  1. AA/CC
  2. Dark Visionary
  3. Super Scientific Tachyon
  4. Grandpa Legacy
